title: Genus-two low-sector pairing
statement: For genus two, e=-b with b>=3, and torsion representatives Gamma in {1,2}, the proposed raw cap bases and cap/fill pairing determine the displayed filtered rational U-recurrence; if the stated geometric continuation and direct-limit identifications hold, the union is sixteen ungraded U-towers.
verified: explicit upper-triangular pairing model with one raw off-diagonal junction
eight junction entries and rank six in the declared model
denominator-free U-recurrence satisfying P U = Q
coordinated integral shear and adverse deletion control
extended finite audit finding exactly one eight-entry off-diagonal block in all 16 declared cases through depth 6
exactly 15 sector-one sources detect the invalid junction deletion in every one of the 36 audited primary-grid cases
unresolved: low-sector applicability of the geometric cap/fill composition formulas
relative classes, signs, homology orientations, and point-action convention
absolute grading, coefficient transport, and novelty

whether this dossier's U-recurrence at Gamma = 0, e = -3 agrees with Chen's explicit U-map formula; Gamma = 0 lies inside Chen's hypothesis, so that comparison would validate the algebraic model against a published computation and has not been done

the extension to Gamma in {1,2}: Chen's Theorem 1 assumes Gamma = 0 or Gamma > 2g-2, so at genus two this dossier's window is exactly the excluded interval, which Chen's Remark 1.5 attributes to the basis choice
nonclaims: the count of sixteen ungraded U-towers at genus two is not new: it is Chen's Theorem 1 for prequantization bundles with e < chi(Sigma), and 2^(2g) traces to dim H^*(Sym^n Sigma) rather than to anything genus-two-specific
the groups are already computed: Nelson and Weiler, J. Symplectic Geom. 21 (2023) 1077-1189, Theorem 1.1, over Z_2 and for all Gamma, making rigorous Farris's 2011 thesis
Nelson and Weiler work over Z_2 and do not define orientations, so this dossier's relative class, sign and orientation assertions have no published counterpart to rely on
smallest_decisive_test: At g=2, b=3, Gamma=1, determine whether Psi_0^epsilon(1 tensor F_1^epsilon(u^2 omega)) = 1 follows from the intended cap/fill composition theorem with the asserted conventions.
